thesis_served: 验证 teacher-student anomaly detection 是否突破 frozen DINOv2-B + 1-NN-max 的 performance ceiling
why_now: E11-E14 已穷尽 frozen-feature/scoring/fusion/lightweight-adaptation 路线；EfficientAD 是唯一未测的不同 paradigm

frozen_config.official_deviation: pretrain_penalty=False (无 ImageNet); 数据用 symlink farm; AUROC/AP 用官方 image_anomaly+detectable 口径

staging.stage0: Bird engineering smoke (12 checks, hard 15-20 min)
staging.stageA: Bird full (advance if dAUROC >= -0.010 AND dAP >= -0.010)
staging.stageB: Car (advance if mean(Bird,Car) dAUROC >= 0 OR mean dAP >= 0, AND any-cat dAUROC >= -0.015)

final_criteria.KEEP: 3-cat mean dAUROC >= +0.010 AND positive >= 2/3 AND Cube dAUROC >= 0 AND mean dAP >= +0.005 AND training stable
final_criteria.HOLD: 3-cat mean dAUROC >= +0.005 AND Cube dAUROC >= -0.005 AND mean dAP >= 0
final_criteria.SOFT_HOLD: overall ~= F0 (+/-0.005) but Cube more stable / error pattern valuable (diagnostic only)
